description.value: Roam Beach Resort is a beachfront property on Qualicum Bay offering newly renovated one- and two-bedroom cabins, twelve numbered RV sites that accommodate vehicles up to 32 feet, and a barrel sauna perched at the ocean's edge for cold-plunge recovery. Situated on the historic Old Island Highway 19 Oceanside Route in central Vancouver Island, it positions touring cyclists within 45 minutes of the Departure Bay ferry and a day-trip radius of Tofino, Cumberland, and Hornby Island. The resort caters to travellers and locals alike with waterfront beach access, a social deck with fire bowl, and on-site laundry.
